tasks.question: Can a different QC parent with odd row weight improve the [44,11,16] lower bound and its parity extension at length45?
methods: Search [I | circ(a) | circ(b) | circ(c)] with block size11, odd a,b and even c; use exact cyclic message-orbit evaluation. The original fixed [45,14,16] parent cannot help: every 11-dimensional subcode has distance16.
